comparisons.peer_topic: Unaudited Pro Forma Financial Results Scope
comparisons.peer_summary: The company provides supplemental consolidated financial results on an unaudited pro forma basis, treating the acquisitions of Xilinx and Pensando as if they occurred at the beginning of fiscal year 2022.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose unaudited pro forma financial information to illustrate the combined results of operations as if significant acquisitions had occurred at the beginning of a prior fiscal year. AVGO presents pro forma data for the VMware acquisition as if it occurred at the beginning of fiscal year 2023, adjusting for intangible asset amortization, stock-based compensation, interest expense, and depreciation. Similarly, AMD provides supplemental consolidated financial results on an unaudited pro forma basis for the Xilinx and Pensando acquisitions, treating them as if consummated at the beginning of fiscal year 2022. Both disclosures serve the same purpose of normalizing historical financials to include the impact of major M&A activity, although the specific target companies and reference dates differ.

sentences.text: The following unaudited pro forma financial information presents combined results of operations for each of the periods presented, as if VMware had been acquired as of the beginning of fiscal year 2023.

The unaudited pro forma information includes adjustments to amortization for intangible assets acquired, stock-based compensation expense, interest expense for acquisition financing, amortization of deferred assets and liabilities, and depreciation for property and equipment acquired.

Following are the supplemental consolidated financial results of the Company, Xilinx and Pensando on an unaudited pro forma basis, as if the acquisitions had been consummated as of the beginning of the fiscal year 2022.

peer_results.rationale: While INTC discusses accounting policies for business combinations and fair value allocations (D050), and interest capitalization (D101), it does not provide the specific unaudited pro forma financial results for specific acquisitions as if they occurred at the beginning of a prior period, which is the specific topic of the target disclosure. D050 focuses on the methodology of purchase price allocation rather than pro forma combined results, and D101 focuses on interest expense presentation, neither of which matches the pro forma acquisition impact topic.

MU's disclosures focus on accounting policies and specific balances for stock-based compensation expense (D023, D091). There is no disclosure in the provided candidates regarding unaudited pro forma financial information for acquisitions, which is the specific topic of the target disclosure.

NVDA's disclosures concern the valuation of acquired assets like intangibles (D088) and property/equipment acquired via assumed liabilities (D100). While these relate to acquisitions, they do not constitute the unaudited pro forma financial results of combined operations as if the acquisition had occurred at a specific prior date, which is the specific topic of the target disclosure.
